review_kind: independent targeted read-only assessment and synthetic fragment probe

finding.status: confirmed baseline defect; repair not yet reviewed
finding.problem: History hydration replaces visible/cache runs with only snapshots from the currently loaded UUID-ascending pages. A newly accepted run outside the first25 disappears on refresh; if all listed runs are terminal the active polling timer is removed.
finding.impact: A successful submit/continuation can vanish immediately and stop receiving automatic status/activity updates. Durable source data remains retained; this is a material activity-discovery/tracking defect.
finding.additional_case: The same omission can occur when the server8MiB page bound returns fewer than25 records.
finding.remediation: Keep a bounded set of explicitly observed/locally accepted run identities in the account/conversation scope. For missing identities, fetch fresh authorized status and then exact-binding/event merges before publishing the union. Do not blindly retain stale cached private payloads. Avoid a server ordering/cursor redesign for this frontend amendment.

repair_review_gates: Greater-than25 UUID-ordered runs retain the newly accepted outside-page activity and polling.
Missing cached runs are freshly authorized by status; denial clears protected state and does not reuse cached payloads.
All five binding fields, scope/refs, original question and parent identity remain immutable.
Read/mutation coordination and late account/selection guards still prevent stale writes.
No fixture fallback or C21 fabricated result.
